verdict.rationale: First-party docs state that Cognee is open source and can run the full memory engine locally or on your own stack for free. They document a single-command Docker deployment for custom deployments, and say the UI and all pipelines can run entirely on your own machine with no account required. The CLI demo also runs offline without API keys. Missing for 10: independent hands-on corroboration of a self-hosted production deployment.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product

citations.quote: Cognee is open source. Run the full memory engine locally or on your own stack — free, forever.
Run Cognee locally using Docker for development, testing, and custom deployments.
Quick start with Docker (single command): docker run --env-file ./.env -p 8000:8000 --rm -it cognee/cognee:main
you can also run the UI and all pipelines entirely on your own machine for free, with no account required, using `cognee.start_ui()`
`cognee-cli demo` gives you a working example with **no API key and no embedding provider**, on a machine with no network access
